toast.confirmDeleteDest: Delete the remote backup destination? Existing backups are unaffected, but future automatic uploads will stop.
toast.autoEnabled: Automatic backups enabled: {{freq}}, {{hour}}:00; the latest {{retention}} backups will be retained

schedule.heading: Automatic Backup Schedule
schedule.description: When enabled, the panel checks hourly. A backup is created at the selected hour, and backups beyond retention are deleted.

none.name: Disabled
none.description: No automatic backups. Only manual “Back Up Now” runs.

daily.name: Daily
daily.description: Creates a backup daily at the selected hour and retains the latest N backups.

weekly.name: Weekly
weekly.description: Creates a backup every seven days to reduce disk usage.

schedule.retentionHint: Older automatic backups beyond this count are deleted. Manual backups are retained.

destination.heading: Remote Backup Destination (FTP / SFTP / S3 / B2)
destination.description: After creation, backups are uploaded to the remote destination in the background for off-site protection against disk failure.
destination.passwordKeepHint: (leave blank to keep the current password)
destination.activeLabel: Active (send every backup to this destination)

restore.title: Restore from backup
restore.modeLabel: What do you want to restore?
restore.cleanLabel: Delete files that are not in the backup
restore.cleanHint: Off by default: live files are kept and only files from the backup are written over them.
restore.targetLabel: Where should the selected files go?

target.folder: Into a new folder (nothing is overwritten)

restore.targetDbHint: Leave empty to overwrite the original. Enter a new name starting with {{prefix}} to restore it alongside.
restore.contentsFailed: The backup contents could not be read.
restore.truncated: Only the first entries are listed.
